checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_xml_valid_xml_document
checkers.description: The input file must be a valid XML document.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_xml_root_tag_is_opendrive
checkers.description: The root element of a valid XML document must be OpenSCENARIO.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_xml_fileheader_is_present
checkers.description: Below the root element a tag with FileHeader must be defined.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_xml_version_is_defined
checkers.description: The FileHeader tag must have the attributes revMajor and revMinor and of type unsignedShort.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_xml_valid_schema
checkers.description: Input xml file must be valid according to the schema.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_lane_level_true_one_side
checkers.description: Check if there is any @Level=False after being True until the lane border.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_lane_access_no_mix_of_deny_or_allow
checkers.description: Check if there is mixed content on access rules for the same sOffset on lanes.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_lane_link_lanes_across_lane_sections
checkers.description: Lanes that continues across the lane sections shall be connected in both directions.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_linkage_is_junction_needed
checkers.description: Two roads shall only be linked directly, if the linkage is clear. If the relationship to successor or predecessor is ambiguous, junctions shall be used.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_lane_link_zero_width_at_start
checkers.description: Lanes that have a width of zero at the beginning of the lane section shall have no predecessor element.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_lane_link_zero_width_at_end
checkers.description: Lanes that have a width of zero at the end of the lane section shall have no successor element.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_lane_link_new_lane_appear
checkers.description: If a new lane appears besides, only the continuing lane shall be connected to the original lane, not the appearing lane.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_junctions_connection_connect_road_no_incoming_road
checkers.description: Connecting roads shall not be incoming roads.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_junctions_connection_one_connection_element
checkers.description: Each connecting road shall be represented by exactly one element. A connecting road may contain as many lanes as required.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_junctions_connection_one_link_to_incoming
checkers.description: Each connecting road shall be associated with at most one <connection> element per incoming road. A connecting road shall only have the <laneLink> element for that direction.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_junctions_connection_start_along_linkage
checkers.description: The value "start" shall be used to indicate that the connecting road runs along the linkage indicated in the element.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_junctions_connection_end_opposite_linkage
checkers.description: The value "end" shall be used to indicate that the connectingroad runs along the opposite direction of the linkage indicated in the element.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_geometry_contact_point
checkers.description: If two roads are connected without a junction, the road reference line of a new road shall always begin at the <contactPoint> element of its successor or predecessor road. The road reference lines may be directed in opposite directions.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_geometry_elem_asc_order
checkers.description: <geometry> elements shall be defined in ascending order along the road reference line according to the s-coordinate.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_geometry_parampoly3_length_match
checkers.description: The actual curve length, as determined by numerical integration over the parameter range, should match '@Length'.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_lane_border_overlap_with_inner_lanes
checkers.description: Lane borders shall not intersect inner lanes.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_geometry_parampoly3_arclength_range
checkers.description: If @prange='arcLength', p shall be chosen in [0, @Length from geometry].

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_geometry_parampoly3_normalized_range
checkers.description: If @prange='normalized', p shall be chosen in [0, 1].

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_road_geometry_parampoly3_valid_parameters
checkers.description: One <geometry> element shall contain only one element that further specifies the geometry of the road.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_performance_avoid_redundant_info
checkers.description: Redundant elements should be avoided.

checkers.name: check_asam_xodr_lane_smoothness_contact_point_no_horizontal_gaps
checkers.description: Two connected drivable lanes shall have no horizontal gaps.
